remarks: Fantastic rental opportunity in one of Greenwich's most popular neighborhoods. Located on a quiet cul-de-sac street, this sunny three-bedroom, two-full-bath ranch features a private backyard and is ready for occupancy on June 1st, 2026. Key features include: An open floor plan-family room and eat-in kitchen, updating with new quartz countertops. Large primary bedroom with an en-suite full bath, plus an additional den/office ideal for working from home. Nicely proportioned secondary bedrooms-full bath. Laundry Room. A detached two-car garage with walk-up storage. Situated right around the corner from the Cos Cob Train Station for an easy city commute. The home is central to everythingGreenwich has to offer, including Cos Cob Park, Mill Pond shopping, Bruce Park, Todds Point Beach and local schools both private and public.

facts.laundryLoc: Laundry room off of primary bathroom
